notes: Source of truth for the task DAG. Coordinator-owned: no task edits this file.
A task may change only paths matching its `owned` globs, plus `alwaysAllowed`. `coordinatorOwned` always wins.
`brief: null` means NOT DISPATCHABLE. Write docs/plan/briefs/<id>.md first, then set the path here.
Keep `owned` globs disjoint between tasks that run at the same time; `skein plan` prints overlaps.
money: true and pii: true make a cross-model review mandatory before merge. `done: true` is set by skein merge.

modelPolicy.principle: The defects that matter are found by cross-model review, whichever model wrote the code. The reviewer is where model strength has the most leverage.
modelPolicy.structure: disjoint file ownership per brief; known-issue notes in briefs so nobody re-investigates; fix rounds resume the author session rather than starting a fresh agent

tasks.title: Kit test harness: tests for the gate's checks and the plan
tasks.notes: Backlog from /skein-init: the gate's standard commands are a syntax pass and the sandbox smoke test only. Brief this after the docs run; wiring it into .skein/config.json standard is a coordinator change.

tasks.title: Fact sheet: every command, gate check, config key and mode, sourced
accept: for c in init upgrade doctor plan brief dispatch watch status send gate review merge; do grep -q "skein $c" docs/facts/FACTS.md || { echo "FACTS.md never names: skein $c"; exit 1; }; done

bt=$(printf '\140'); for c in brief clean-tree boundary secrets test-integrity invariants standard e2e accept; do grep -qF "$bt$c$bt" docs/facts/FACTS.md || { echo "FACTS.md never names the gate check $c in backticks"; exit 1; }; done

bt=$(printf '\140'); for k in version name prefix mode envelope coordinatorEnv plan briefs reviews vendor gate baseBranch board driver maxAgents install standard e2e invariants monotonic secretPatterns secretAllow worker review workerPrompt readyMarker setupScript setupTimeout setupFatal projects; do grep -qF "$bt$k$bt" docs/facts/FACTS.md || { echo "FACTS.md never names the config key $k in backticks"; exit 1; }; done

for v in SKEIN_MAX_AGENTS SKEIN_PROJECT_ID SKEIN_DRIVER SKEIN_BOARD SKEIN_USER_CONFIG SKEIN_WORKTREES SKEIN_RUNS SKEIN_STATE_DIR SKEIN_KIT_GIT; do grep -q "$v" docs/facts/FACTS.md || { echo "FACTS.md never names: $v"; exit 1; }; done
for s in init brief coordinate gate status; do grep -q "/skein-$s" docs/facts/FACTS.md || { echo "FACTS.md never names: /skein-$s"; exit 1; }; done

tasks.title: Architecture diagram: SVG plus its source
accept: for w in coordinator board wps.json brief worker worktree gate review merge; do grep -qi "$w" docs/assets/architecture.svg || { echo "architecture.svg has no label containing: $w"; exit 1; }; done

tasks.title: Task lifecycle diagram: SVG plus its source
accept: for w in brief dispatch watch gate review merge fix pii; do grep -qi "$w" docs/assets/lifecycle.svg || { echo "lifecycle.svg has no label containing: $w"; exit 1; }; done

tasks.title: README upgrade
accept: for h in 'Why it exists' 'What you get' 'Quickstart' 'How a task moves' 'Local mode' 'Config' 'Principles' 'Upgrading' 'Limitations'; do grep -q "^## $h" README.md || { echo "README.md lacks the section: ## $h"; exit 1; }; done

grep -oE '\]\([^)]+\)' README.md | sed -E 's/^\]\(//; s/\)$//; s/[[:space:]].*$//; s/#.*$//' | grep -vE '^(https?:|mailto:|$)' | while read -r p; do [ -e "$p" ] || { echo "broken link: $p"; exit 1; }; done
grep -oE 'src="[^"]+"' README.md | sed -E 's/^src="//; s/"$//' | grep -vE '^https?:' | while read -r p; do [ -e "$p" ] || { echo "broken image: $p"; exit 1; }; done

for f in docs/assets/architecture.svg docs/assets/lifecycle.svg docs/assets/demo.gif docs/limitations.md examples/hello-swarm; do grep -qF "$f" README.md || { echo "README.md never links $f"; exit 1; }; done
tasks.notes: Owner gate (docs/plan/docs-run.md, rule 7): do not merge until the owner has read the diff and said yes. SK-09 fact-checks this branch first.

tasks.title: Runnable example repo: examples/hello-swarm
accept: jq -e '.mode == "local" and .board.type == "none" and .driver.type == "local" and .prefix == "HS" and (.monotonic | length) > 0' examples/hello-swarm/.skein/config.json

for p in AGENTS.md scripts/skein .github .superset docs/plan/COORDINATOR.md; do ! test -e "examples/hello-swarm/$p" || { echo "examples/hello-swarm/$p: skein init renders this in the sandbox, so do not commit it"; exit 1; }; done

r=$(pwd) && d=$(mktemp -d) && cp -R examples/hello-swarm/. "$d"/ && cd "$d" && git init -q -b main && git add -A && git -c user.name=sandbox -c user.email=sandbox@localhost -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm sandbox && node "$r/lib/plan.mjs" --json > "$d.json" && [ "$(jq '.tasks | length' "$d.json")" = 3 ] && [ "$(jq '[.tasks[] | select(.status == "ready")] | length' "$d.json")" = 2 ] && [ "$(jq '.conflicts | length' "$d.json")" = 0 ]

tasks.title: Demo recording: scripted vhs tape and GIF
accept: d=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 docs/assets/demo.gif) && awk -v d="$d" 'BEGIN { exit !(d >= 60 && d <= 90) }'
grep -qi 'worker commits scripted for the recording' docs/demo/README.md

tasks.title: Docs site (optional): Next.js and Fumadocs, static export
accept: cd docs/site && npm ci && npm run build && test -f out/index.html
tasks.notes: Optional (docs/plan/docs-run.md): brief it only if SK-04 merges cleanly and the owner still wants the site; the accept list gets an internal link check then. coordinator: true because it owns a file under .github/. Owner gate before merge, and a second fact-check pass over the site.

tasks.title: Cross-model fact-check of the docs
accept: awk -F'|' '/^\| *claim *\|/ { t = 1; next } t && /^\| *:?-/ { next } t && /^\|/ { n++; v = $4; f = $5; gsub(/[ \t*]/, "", v); gsub(/[ \t]/, "", f); if (v !~ /^(ok|wrong|unsourced)$/) { print "row " n ": the verdict must be ok, wrong or unsourced: " $0; bad = 1 } else if (v != "ok" && f == "") { print "row " n ": a " v " verdict needs a fix: " $0; bad = 1 }; next } t { t = 0 } END { if (!n) { print "no claim rows under the table header"; bad = 1 }; exit bad }' docs/plan/reviews/docs-factcheck.md

for f in README.md docs/limitations.md examples/hello-swarm/README.md docs/demo/README.md; do grep -qF "$f" docs/plan/reviews/docs-factcheck.md || { echo "the fact-check never names $f"; exit 1; }; done
tasks.notes: Dispatch only after SK-04's worker reports DONE and its gate passes: it reviews SK-04's branch before the owner does. Dispatch with --model claude-fable-5-1, a different model from the writers (codex here is a shim, docs/plan/COORDINATOR.md). coordinator: true because its file is under docs/plan/.

tasks.title: Swarm run log
tasks.notes: The coordinator writes this itself (docs/plan/docs-run.md, Owner checkpoints); never dispatch it. Add SK-08 to its deps if the site is built. When it lands, the README gets its closing line.

tasks.title: Example: pass --name and --prefix to skein init
accept: r=$(pwd) && d=$(mktemp -d) && cp -R examples/hello-swarm/. "$d"/ && cd "$d" && git init -q -b main && git add -A && git -c user.name=sandbox -c user.email=sandbox@localhost -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm sandbox && cmd=$(grep -m1 -E '^skein init ' README.md) && [ -n "$cmd" ] && "$r/bin/skein" ${cmd#skein } >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -q 'HS_WORKER_DONE' AGENTS.md && grep -q 'HS_COORDINATOR' scripts/githooks/pre-push
tasks.notes: Follow-up from SK-06: plain skein init in a mktemp -d sandbox renders AGENTS.md and the hook with a prefix derived from the folder name, not the config's HS. Runs beside SK-04 (disjoint files).

tasks.title: Example: one task per skein dispatch
accept: grep -qF 'skein dispatch HS-01' examples/hello-swarm/README.md && grep -qF 'skein dispatch HS-02' examples/hello-swarm/README.md
tasks.notes: Follow-up from SK-09: the example README passed two task ids to one skein dispatch, which dispatches only the last.
